project.name: Sylphx Website
project.summary: Company website frontend for Sylphx with public pages, Solid/Vite build tooling, static assets, Vercel configuration, and website-local UI behavior.
goals: Present the Sylphx company website as a fast, maintainable, static frontend.
Keep company pages, navigation, legal pages, design-system helpers, assets, build configuration, and deployment configuration coherent.
Keep the website content-oriented and avoid hidden product or runtime coupling.
nonGoals: Own backend product APIs, authentication, billing, customer data, or product runtime behavior.
Own shared design doctrine, reusable frontend framework policy, or all Sylphx marketing content strategy outside this site.
Publish enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, org rulesets, rollout issue reconciliation, or shared CI policy.

owns.name: company-website-pages
owns.description: Public website pages, navigation, legal pages, copy, static assets, and site-local content presentation.

owns.name: website-frontend-runtime
owns.description: Solid/Vite frontend setup, design-system helpers, toast state, build configuration, and website-local UI components.

owns.name: website-deployment-config
owns.description: Static build and Vercel configuration used to publish the company website.

doesNotOwn: Product backend APIs, authentication, billing, customer data, product runtime behavior, or other products' website sections.
Shared design doctrine, reusable frontend framework policy, or @sylphx/zen package behavior.
Enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, rollout issue reconciliation, org rulesets, or shared workflow implementation.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema, standards, and rollout audit

forbiddenCouplings: Do not add backend product runtime, auth, billing, or customer-data ownership to the company website repository.
Do not import shared packages through internal source paths instead of documented package exports.
Do not make other products depend on website-local components, copy, or deployment assumptions.
Do not publish enterprise process policy from this repository instead of SylphxAI/doctrine or SylphxAI/.github.

delivery.deployPath: No repository-local CI workflow is present; changes are validated with relevant Bun, Vite, Biome, and static preview checks, then deployed through the configured hosting path.
delivery.productionProof: Website changes require hosting readback and smoke evidence for affected public pages, static assets, metadata, and legal routes.

gaps.description: Add repository CI for install, build, lint, and static route smoke before relying on automated admission.
Reconcile README technology claims with the current Solid/Vite implementation and package scripts.
Document the hosting URL, preview/readback checks, and page smoke evidence required after website changes.
